notes: Identity verified from supplied transcription: article title Measuring Global Oral Proficiency in SLA Research: A New Elicited Imitation Test of L2 Chinese; Shu-Ling Wu and Lourdes Ortega; Foreign Language Annals 46(4), 680–704, 2013; DOI 10.1111/flan.12063 on PDF page 1. Cache is a Scribd-hosted, page-labelled transcription of the primary article, including methods, results, discussion, references and appendices across 25 pages, rather than an abstract or secondary report. OCR/callback formatting retained in evidence. No source PDF was supplied; layout could not be independently rendered. Analytic N arithmetic: 40 + 40 = 80, from explicitly compared mutually exclusive final groups; no df-based derivation. Printed p 0.000 retained exactly. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
